model_resource.asset_integrity: every mesh file's digest was verified against the bundle manifest when the bundle was loaded, and is re-verified per request before bytes leave the process

semantics.links: the frozen compiled reference layout: parent_name, joint name/type/axis, local_transform as the body offset in the parent body frame, and every geom with type, size, transform, rgba and mesh_asset_id
